soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 / def:odd-witness / def:model-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The declared constants need not make the model or witness nonempty: |Y|≤B and σ²≥v_min require at least B²≥v_min, while the two-point witness needs explicit slack such as B>sqrt(v_min) after its mean envelope is accounted for.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 21--23, Section 4.3.2 and Lemma 10; p. 57, Appendix S2.4.3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For continuous Z the paper explicitly restricts optimization to K prespecified weighting functions and obtains the minimum-variance member within that finite class.
The paper gives finite-dimensional basis projections and an abstract infinite indexed influence-function/minimum-variance characterization for the mean-scale model.
The paper establishes cross-fit spline remainder results for average linear functionals and describes the distinct-subsample mechanism for product/nonlinearity bias control.
The article introduces boundary-adaptive local-polynomial conditional-density estimators with pointwise and uniform concentration and distributional approximation results.
The article develops large-sample and uniform-inference results for partitioning-based series estimators, including splines and locally supported bases.
The paper develops sharp matrix laws and growing-series pointwise/uniform theory, including conditions near K/n up to logarithms.
The article establishes asymptotic normality and consistent sieve variance estimation for functionals in semi/nonparametric conditional-moment models.
The article establishes the orthogonal-score and cross-fitting route to root-n approximately normal inference with learned nuisances.
The paper derives efficient estimation for multivalued treatment effects under ignorability, including joint treatment-effect inference and overidentification gains.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add an explicit nonemptiness/slack condition, for example B>sqrt(v_min) plus a displayed bound on |psi_x|, |gamma|, |gamma3|, and sigma_wit that certifies the odd-h witness lies in the outcome envelope.

Promote the finite-family comparison into a formal two-comparator frontier statement: state the strict relation to GuoLiuBenkeserNabi2026Napkin's prescribed family and the specialization/complement relation to NabiGuoLiu2026VermaEfficiency's abstract projection class.

Add a quantitative approximation frontier for prescribed dictionaries (for example, a sharp worst-case lower bound or optimal M-term gap) to distinguish global attainment from the routine Hilbert-projection consequence of the existing abstract geometry.

recommended_next_step: Revise the primitive class and witness with an explicit B--v_min feasibility margin, then advance the repaired field-tier kernel to Stage 0.
